name: UMCCA
recent: Prosper Trading 与 Tee 家族联合提出的无条件强制全面收购要约已转为无条件，持股达 56.45%。董事 Tee Cheng Hua 在公开市场持续增持股份。公司也发布了月度产量数据。
notable: Prosper Trading 与 Tee 家族联合提出的强制全面收购要约转为无条件，持股达 56.45%。
独立顾问通函已就上述强制全面收购要约发出。
董事 Tee Cheng Hua 于 11 月 10 日至 17 日期间多次在公开市场增持股份。
risks: 联合收购方持股已超过 50%，公众持股比例可能下降。
董事及大股东在收购期间持续增持股份。

news.title: United Malacca takeover offer turns unconditional as stake hits 56.45%
Prosper Trading Buys 120,600 United Malacca Shares at RM6.09-RM6.10 During Take-Over
United Malacca's executive director Lip Sin passes away [WATCH]

recent_en: The unconditional mandatory general offer by Prosper Trading and the Tee family joint ultimate offerors has turned unconditional with a 56.45% stake. Director Tee Cheng Hua has been continuously acquiring shares in the open market. The company also released monthly production figures.
notable_en: The mandatory general offer by Prosper Trading and the Tee family joint ultimate offerors turned unconditional with a 56.45% stake.
Independent advice circular issued in relation to the mandatory general offer.
Director Tee Cheng Hua acquired shares multiple times in the open market between 10 and 17 November.
risks_en: The joint offerors' stake has exceeded 50%, which may reduce public shareholding spread.
Directors and substantial shareholders have been continuously acquiring shares during the offer period.
